title.narrative: Tuinuwe Bishara Mupakani

description.narrative: The overall objective of EWICBT Project Phase II is to to contribute to the mitigation of effects of conflict between DRC and Rwanda through the empowerment of Women Informal Cross Border Traders. This offers Rwandans and Congolese an opportunity to collaborate for common commercial interests that benefit the Great Lakes Region. This will be achieved through continuous improvement of WICBTs business environment through advocacy and increasing their income as well as their socio-economic welfare.
